en.explanation:
f(x) = (3x2 + ax – 2 – a)ex

f'(x) = ex(6x + a) + (3x2 + ax – 2 – a)ex

= ex(3x2 + x(6 + a) – 2)

f '(x) = 0 at x = 1

3 + (6 + a) – 2 = 0

a = -7

f'(x) = ex(3x2 – x – 2)

= ex(x – 1) (3x + 2)
x = 1 is a local minima and x = is a local maxima of f.
